variant.made_by: scratch wrapper .scratch/w129/regrade_wrapper.py sets dv.BASIS_CENSUS to the copied census csv before commonwealth_sweep_regrade.main; the baseline used the same wrapper with the original census path; no product file edited

changed.residue_floor_unit: absolute difference in daily return (a fraction); 1 basis point = 0.0001
changed.by_fund_overlap_note: an account-day that held two moved funds is counted under each

years.grade_table: none: month_grades carries month verdicts only

headline: For the 19 validated funds whose price moved (of 33 validated; the other 14 were already on the cached close and did not move), 1,575 of 107,316 account-days measured in both builds change (residue floor 1e-9 of return): 1,054 under 1 basis point, 425 from 1 to 10, 96 over 10. This is for the validated funds only and is not the size of the whole defect: 237 of 270 fund series are not validated and are not in this number.
not_established: The number is for the 33 validated fund series only (19 left on the store's adjusted close + 14 already substituted). 237 of 270 fund series are not validated (no cached close, no reinvestment row, or fewer than the minimum dates) and are not in any count here; it is not the size of the whole defect.

Only 5 of the 19 moved funds (ANCFX, BALCX, CAIBX, CWGIX, FCNTX) are held on any account-day that is measured in both builds; the other 14 moved funds change price but no measured-in-both account-day holds them (they sit on account-days that are blank, mostly UNPRICED under either build). The number is therefore driven by those 5 funds.

The comparison is one build of the chain against another at the pinned split store and the cached Yahoo Close; it does not say which price is right for a fund, only what changes when the validated unadjusted close replaces the store's adjusted price. ACTDX is classed as_traded in the census and is changed to dividend_adjusted in the copy as the order directs; it moves only by 4 dropped days (no closing price differs).

Distribution dates are the custodian's posting dates (types dv, dvlt, dvst, dvr) of the moved funds, taken at fund level (any account's row that day, 613 dates across the 19 funds); ex-dates are not held on disk, so 'on a distribution date' means the posting date, not the ex-date.

Attribution to a fund is by holding on the changed day or on the account's previous valued day (the return on day d reads the value at d-1 and d); an account-day holding two moved funds counts under each, so the per-fund counts overlap (1,214 hold one, 361 hold two; the per-fund counts sum to 1,936).

The grade tables carry month grades only. There is no account-year grade table; the year line is this worker's own chain (product of 1+return over the measured days of a calendar year) for account-years with the same measured days in both builds, and is not a Commonwealth year grade.

Price stores (gold holdings, rival funds) were re-read from S3 today and are not pinned (only the split store is); the baseline equals the served returns exactly, so any store drift did not reach a return. The served copy is the r34 serve; no later served copy was compared.
No explanation is offered for why a change lands on a given date or fund beyond the counts (the two largest changes, about 882 basis points, are on one date in one fund); no account was examined.
Direction is counted, not explained: of the changed account-days the variant return is lower on 747 and higher on 828; on a distribution date 11 lower and 9 higher.
